overview: The Chamber of Judgement is where Seru’s doctrine becomes punishment. Sentences are enacted, purity violations are purged, and decree‑bound executions are performed.
history: Constructed as the final stage of Seru’s judicial hierarchy.
Arcane execution pylons were added to stabilize decree magic.
Purity‑purge chambers were introduced to remove ideological corruption.
Praetorian ritual galleries were integrated to oversee sentencing.
hooks: A ritual platform destabilizes during a decree execution.
A purity‑purge chamber reports a corrupted resonance signature.
A Praetorian ritual officer requests assistance with a sealed Tribunal sentence.
